stem.text: A beam of vertically polarised light is incident normally on a polarising filter. The filter can be rotated so that it is always in a plane perpendicular to the beam. The transmission axis of the filter is initially vertical.

stem.alt: Tilted polarising filter with a beam of light incident on it; labels: beam of vertically polarised light waves, polarising filter, transmission axis of polarising filter, transmitted light.

stem.text: The filter is first rotated clockwise by an angle of $30^{\circ}$ so that the transmitted light waves have intensity $I_{30}$. The filter is then rotated clockwise by a further angle of $30^{\circ}$.
What is the new intensity of the transmitted light waves?
